name: durable-streams
description: Effect-first Durable Streams protocol and memory host.

scripts.typecheck: bun run build && bun run --filter '*' typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run lint:general && bun run lint:effect
scripts.lint:fix: bun run lint:general:fix && bun run lint:effect:fix
scripts.test:conformance: bun run test:conformance:memory && bun run test:conformance:sqlite && bun run test:conformance:workerd && bun run test:conformance:ownership && bun run test:conformance:fetch
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/storage build && bun run --cwd packages/views build && bun run --cwd packages/serve build && bun run --cwd packages/projection build
scripts.hosted:check: bun run --cwd hosted typecheck && bun run --cwd hosted test
scripts.pack:dry-run: for dir in packages/core packages/storage packages/projection packages/views packages/serve; do (cd "$dir" && bun pm pack --dry-run) || exit; done
scripts.site:validate: env CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false bun run --cwd site check:terms && env CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false bun run --cwd site check:excerpts && env CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false bun run --cwd site check && env CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false bun run --cwd site build && env CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false bun run --cwd site check:og && env CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false bun run --cwd site check:links
